dedupe_keys.name: trazo agricultural field boundaries and annotations for south america wri data lab

description: Trazo is a WRI field boundary dataset and family of deep learning models built on the Fields of The World baseline to support supply chain traceability in South America. The fields dataset has 10,935,129 field boundaries for the 2023 to 2024 planting season across Brazil (for example Mato Grosso, Pará, São Paulo and Rio Grande do Sul), Argentina, Paraguay and Bolivia, generated from Sentinel-2 imagery by U-Net models (Trazo1, Trazo2, Trazo3) trained on annotations from 17 soy-producing ecoregions and cleaned by post-processing and expert review; Trazo3 is recommended for most uses. A companion annotations dataset gives 256 by 256 pixel training chips with interior, boundary and background labels, split into training, validation and test folders, compatible with the Fields of The World pipeline. Both are hosted on Source Cooperative under CC BY 4.0 and were last updated in July 2026. Caveats: boundaries are model outputs, counts differ between models, and earlier early-adopter releases are superseded. For simulation it gives the field units of South American soy and grain production, useful for deforestation-free supply chain checks under the EU Deforestation Regulation and for field-level crop exposure. Related catalogue records include the Crop Map of England and the global grassland maps.
